searchText: Say i stake and only want to take out a chunk of that rewards without losing my place, is that going to be possible? I asked this a while ago but there weren’t any clarity back then. Thanks it hasn't been determined yet but generally speaking, the community seems to be in line with that thinking. wanting to have a method to take the excess balance out without having to stop staking either way, withdrawals are at least a year away
